import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

data = """date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36
2024-01-01,02:00,Cappuccino,Medium,4.01,3,Credit Card,35-44,1,12.03

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().reset_index()

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='product', y='total', data=product_sales.sort_values('total', ascending=False))
plt.title('Total Sales per Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
